'''2007 Georgia State Championship Scott Osborne DS Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Osborne]] at [[2007 Georgia State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
